name: know-qa-agent
description: v0.1.0 — Point it at any web app and it tests like a skeptical engineer, then reports what broke and why, with the evidence. A deterministic engine tracks the full test matrix so requested coverage can't silently disappear. Accessibility is first-class: a full axe-core ruleset pass and exact WCAG AA contrast math, each finding carrying the success criteria it maps to, with anything the tools cannot resolve reported as needs-review rather than guessed. Findings come back triaged, deduplicated, and ready to file, and a team can split the app into owned areas with roll-ups posted to Slack. Standalone.
